name: moodboard-mcp
description: Use Pinterest boards as design references. Paste any public board link (no login), or log in for your own boards. Claude sees the images and gets extracted design tokens.
long_description: Works instantly with any PUBLIC Pinterest board link: no account, keys or setup. Claude sees the pin images and can extract a color palette with roles, contrast ratios, CSS variables and Tailwind colors. Optional Pinterest login (official OAuth, read-only) adds your private boards and search.

tools.name: get_public_board
tools.description: Read any public board from its link (no login)

tools.name: get_board_pins
tools.description: Get pins from a board, with images

tools.name: get_pin
tools.description: Get one pin with its image

tools.name: extract_design_tokens
tools.description: Palette, color roles, contrast, CSS and Tailwind from a board

prompts.name: moodboard_to_ui
prompts.description: Study a Pinterest board and build a UI in the same style
prompts.text: Use Pinterest board ${arguments.board} as the visual reference for: ${arguments.build}.

pinterest_client_id.title: Advanced: your own Pinterest App ID
pinterest_client_id.description: Not needed for public board links. Only if you want to log in with your own Pinterest developer app.

pinterest_client_secret.title: Advanced: your own Pinterest App secret
pinterest_client_secret.description: Only with your own Pinterest app. Leave empty otherwise.

pinterest_access_token.title: Advanced: access token
pinterest_access_token.description: Optional: a token generated in the Pinterest developer portal. Skips the OAuth login.
